messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: region0-primary GPU pool queue depth > 6000 and autoscaler not increasing capacity. Observed 98% utilization on primary GPUs. Fallback/spillover policy did NOT trigger. Auto-remediation attempted but failed (see logs). Paging on-call: @erica_oncall and ops leads.

erica_oncall: seeing same in console, opening thread. Is this affecting customer response rates or just internal queue?

matt_ops: queue growth is causing request throttles for some customers routed to region0. Telemetry: 5xx rate +2.1%, p99 latency up ~600ms for affected models. Not global yet but growing.

kevin_eng: autoscaler logs show repeated failures: "scale request blocked: quota-check failed" followed by "autoscaler backoff: rate-limit-window". Looks like a combination of quota and a bug in our cooldown loop. Pasting excerpt: 

```
Oct 21 15:02:12 autoscaler region0 controller.go:242 "scale attempt" desired=12 current=8 reason="queue>threshold"
Oct 21 15:02:13 platform quota-check.go:88 "quota denied" user=system message="insufficient-gpu-quota for region0: requested 4, available 0"
Oct 21 15:02:13 autoscaler controller.go:310 "enter cooldown" backoff=30s reason="quota-fallback"
Oct 21 15:02:44 autoscaler controller.go:242 "scale attempt" desired=12 current=8 reason="queue>threshold"
Oct 21 15:02:45 autoscaler controller.go:315 "scale request failed" err="rpc: connection reset by peer"
```

kevin_eng: also see the routing agent didn't start spillover to region1 because the policy expected an "autoscale-failed" signal we never emitted. So two failure modes: (1) quota + provider limits blocked scaling, (2) routing policy didn't detect and route.

julia_prod: customer-impact quick summary for support: which customers are affected and do we need to issue a notice? Sophie, can you triage top impacted tenants?

sophie_support: running tenant impact query now. Early numbers: ~18 customers have >10% error rate, 4 customers seeing >25% request failures. Two high-volume customers (cust-A, cust-B) on region0 experiencing severe degradation. Opening incident tickets for both and notifying AMs.

incident-bot: :spiral_calendar_pad: Incident created: INC-2026-6572. Priority: P1 — degradation of production inference in region0, potential for broader outage if queue continues to grow.

erica_oncall: immediate mitigation plan: 1) force enable cross-region spillover to region1 for region0 routes, 2) manually provision emergency reserved capacity in region0 if possible, 3) throttle low-priority tenants to reduce queue. Who can run spillover toggle?

matt_ops: I can flip the spillover policy via console, but want to do it in staged fashion. Command (running):

```
# force spillover routing for region0 -> region1
redwoodctl routes update --region region0 --spillover-policy force --target region1 --reason "autoscale-stuck emergency"
```

matt_ops: executing now. Expect some requests to start routing to region1 within 30s. Monitoring logs.

sre_bot: :white_check_mark: Routing update accepted. New policy applied. Starting gradual reroute: 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 2m steps to avoid cold-start avalanche.

kevin_eng: while reroute is progressive, we need reserved capacity in region1 to handle the spike. region1 has free quota but we need to provision an on-demand pool. Command to provision:

```
redwoodctl capacity reserve --region region1 --gpu-type a100 --count 8 --duration 2h --label emergency-evac
```

kevin_eng: provisioning now. If provisioning succeeds, spillover will ramp to full. If it fails, we must widen routing to other regions or enable model variant fallback to CPU-quantized models.

incident-bot: :hourglass_flowing_sand: Provisioning requested. Provider response pending.

(30s pass)

matt_ops: spillover at 10% -> p99 for region0 dropping slightly. Queue depth decreasing from 6200 -> 4100. Monitoring.

kevin_eng: provisioning returned errors: cloud-provider returned "quotaExceeded" for region1 in the target sku. That explains earlier quota pattern. We have exhausted on-demand GPU quota in our org across regions.

erica_oncall: we can't rely on reserve capacity. Alternative plan: a) force model variant fallback for non-critical tenants to smaller quantized variant (frees GPU mem + throughput), b) apply emergency tenant throttling, c) increase spillover fanout to regions 2 and 3, d) open cloud quota emergency ticket.

matt_ops: running variant fallback for low-priority routes. Command:

```
redwoodctl routes set-variant --region region0 --selector "tier=free,priority=low" --variant quantized-8bit --reason "emergency memory/throughput"
```

matt_ops: applying now. Expect decreased per-request GPU time but potential quality delta. Notifying product.

julia_prod: acknowledged. Notifying data-science and CS that we are enabling quantized variants for free-tier. Will prepare messaging in case of quality regression.

sophie_support: pushing out advisory to affected customers: short automated note letting them know we are mitigating and may see quality differences for non-critical routes.

(2m pass)

matt_ops: spillover ramped to 50% then 100% across region1 and region2. Queue depth now 1200 and falling. Error rates stabilizing. p95/p99 latency trending back to baseline for most tenants.

kevin_eng: root cause hypothesis so far: autoscaler attempted to scale but cloud quota prevented instance creation. Our autoscaler then entered a backoff loop and did not emit a strong enough "capacity-failure" signal for the routing layer, so spillover didn't trigger automatically. Two gaps: quota awareness and signal coupling between autoscaler and routing agent.

erica_oncall: ongoing actions checklist: 
- [ ] Keep spillover forced until autoscaler health is restored or quotas resolved.
- [ ] Open quota emergency with cloud provider (kevin) — include list of SKUs and timestamps.
- [ ] Patch autoscaler to emit failure telemetry (kevin + eng).
- [ ] Create rollback for variant fallback when capacity normalizes (julia).
- [ ] Customer follow-ups (sophie).

kevin_eng: opened cloud emergency ticket CHG-99821 with provider. They responded SLA: 2h to review. Also raising internal ticket to increase org quota.

incident-bot: :pager: PagerDuty notified: on-call escalation handed from @erica_oncall to @matt_ops for mitigation window.

matt_ops: I will own mitigation for the next 2 hours. Please send any infra updates here.

(30m pass)

matt_ops: provider increased quota in region2 only, not region1. We redirected spillover to region2 where reserved capacity successfully provisioned. RPS redistributed. region0 queue drained to <200. Errors down to baseline.

sophie_support: customer-impact update: cust-A and cust-B returned to normal. We sent targeted notes to affected accounts. No customer SLA credits requested yet; CS will track downstream.

erica_oncall: putting a 1-hour watch window on the incident, then will transition to postmortem tracking after stabilization. Any open tasks?

kevin_eng: filing infra bug: AUTOSCALE-1425 "autoscaler fails to surface quota errors to routing agent causing spillover not to trigger." Assigning to autoscale team, priority P0. Also adding telemetry: emit metric "autoscaler.scale_block_reason" with tag=quota|rpc|rate-limit.

julia_prod: we'll author a short public incident note if customers ask. Internally, product will evaluate quality impact from quantized fallback and create a plan to avoid fallback for high-value customers.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident INC-2026-6572 mitigations in place. Status: stabilized -> monitoring. Owner: matt_ops. Postmortem: scheduled for 2026-10-22 10:00 UTC.

matt_ops: final notes before handoff: keep spillover policy in 'force' state until autoscaler patch and quota increase confirmed. I'll document exact commands used and timeline in the incident ticket.

erica_oncall: handing back on-call. Thanks everyone. Postmortem items: quota automation, stronger routing signals, emergency reserved-capacity playbook, tenant throttling runbook and clearer customer messaging templates.

pagerduty: :white_check_mark: Handoff complete.

kevin_eng: created follow-up tickets: AUTOSCALE-1425, ROUTER-881 "route-signal-coupling", QUOTA-321 "auto-request-quota-on-emergency".

sophie_support: closing customer-notification loop. CS will follow up with any request for credits or detailed impact reports.

julia_prod: adding evaluation job to run baseline regressions comparing quantized variants vs full models for critical prompts.

incident-bot: thread closed to new automated alerts for this incident.

matt_ops: closing thread, saving logs and command history to INC-2026-6572. Thanks all!
